description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for the REST API layer of a transportation management system. It includes error classes, JSON response helpers, database query helpers, request argument validators, SQL safety validators, and logging functions.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Base class for API-related errors that can be converted into JSON responses. Stores message, status code, and optional payload.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Represents a 404 Not Found error with a default message, inheriting from ApiError.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Represents a 400 Bad Request error with a default message, inheriting from ApiError.

methods.name: Response json_response(payload: Any, status_code: int = 200)
methods.description: Returns a Flask Response object with JSON payload and specific status code.

methods.name: Response legacy_list_error(message: str, status_code: int = 400)
methods.description: Creates a JSON response with an error message wrapped in a list, preserving legacy API error shape.

methods.name: Response legacy_list_status(status: str, message: str, status_code: int = 200, **extra_fields: Any)
methods.description: Creates a JSON response with a status and message, wrapped in a list, preserving legacy login/status shape.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _rows_to_dicts(cursor)
methods.description: Converts a database cursor's results into a list of dictionaries using the cursor description for keys.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all_as_dicts(cursor, sql: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns all results as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: int require_int_arg(args, name: str, *, minimum: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves and validates a required integer argument from request.args, enforcing minimum value.

methods.name: Optional[int] optional_int_arg(args, name: str, *, minimum: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves an optional integer argument from request.args, enforcing minimum value if present.

methods.name: str validate_sql_identifier(identifier: str, *, kind: str = "identifier")
methods.description: Validates that a SQL identifier (table/column name) contains only safe characters.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Tuple[Any,...]] make_select_all_sql(table: str, *, limit: Optional[int] = None, offset: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Constructs a safe SQL SELECT statement with optional LIMIT and OFFSET parameters.

methods.name: None log_exception(operation: str, exc: Exception, *, extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Logs an exception with operation context and optional extra data.

methods.name: __init__(self, message: str = "Invalid request", payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
__init__(self, message: str = "Not Found", payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
__init__(self, message: str, status_code: int = 400, payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
